<?php
// payment_controller.php - Payment Processing System with RBAC

class RoleManager {
    private $pdo;
    private $roleHierarchy = [
        'super_admin' => 0xFF,
        'admin'       => 0x0F,
        'manager'     => 0x07,
        'operator'    => 0x03,
        'viewer'      => 0x01
    ];

    public function __construct(PDO $pdo) {
        $this->pdo = $pdo;
    }

    public function getUserPermissionLevel(int $userId): int {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare(
            'SELECT role, custom_permissions FROM users WHERE id = :id'
        );
        $stmt->execute([':id' => $userId]);
        $user = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        if (!$user) return 0;

        $baseLevel = $this->roleHierarchy[$user['role']] ?? 0;
        $customPerms = (int)$user['custom_permissions'];
        
        // Combine base role with any custom permission grants
        // Custom permissions use bitwise OR to extend base permissions
        return $this->computeEffectivePermissions($baseLevel, $customPerms);
    }

    private function computeEffectivePermissions(int $base, int $custom): int {
        // Security: custom permissions can only ADD within the same tier
        // They cannot elevate beyond the next role level
        $maxAllowed = ($base << 1) | 0x01;
        $combined = $base | $custom;
        return $combined & $maxAllowed;
    }

    public function canProcessPayment(int $permLevel, float $amount): bool {
        // Permission levels for payment processing:
        // >= 0x03 (operator): up to $1,000
        // >= 0x07 (manager): up to $50,000  
        // >= 0x0F (admin): up to $500,000
        // >= 0xFF (super_admin): unlimited
        if ($amount <= 1000.0 && $permLevel >= 0x03) return true;
        if ($amount <= 50000.0 && $permLevel >= 0x07) return true;
        if ($amount <= 500000.0 && $permLevel >= 0x0F) return true;
        if ($permLevel >= 0xFF) return true;
        return false;
    }
}

class PaymentProcessor {
    private $pdo;
    private $roleManager;
    private $auditLog;

    public function __construct(PDO $pdo, RoleManager $rm, AuditLog $log) {
        $this->pdo = $pdo;
        $this->roleManager = $rm;
        $this->auditLog = $log;
    }

    public function initiatePayment(int $userId, array $paymentData): array {
        $amount = (float)($paymentData['amount'] ?? 0);
        $recipient = $paymentData['recipient'] ?? '';
        $memo = $paymentData['memo'] ?? '';

        if ($amount <= 0 || empty($recipient)) {
            return ['success' => false, 'error' => 'Invalid payment data'];
        }

        $permLevel = $this->roleManager->getUserPermissionLevel($userId);
        
        if (!$this->roleManager->canProcessPayment($permLevel, $amount)) {
            $this->auditLog->logDenied($userId, $amount, $permLevel);
            return ['success' => false, 'error' => 'Insufficient permissions'];
        }

        return $this->executePayment($userId, $amount, $recipient, $memo);
    }

    public function batchProcess(int $userId, array $payments): array {
        $results = [];
        $permLevel = $this->roleManager->getUserPermissionLevel($userId);
        
        // Batch optimization: check aggregate permission once
        $totalAmount = array_sum(array_column($payments, 'amount'));
        
        // For batch, we verify against individual max, not total
        $maxIndividual = max(array_column($payments, 'amount'));
        
        if (!$this->roleManager->canProcessPayment($permLevel, $maxIndividual)) {
            return ['success' => false, 'error' => 'Batch contains payments exceeding permission level'];
        }

        foreach ($payments as $payment) {
            $results[] = $this->executePayment(
                $userId,
                (float)$payment['amount'],
                $payment['recipient'],
                $payment['memo'] ?? ''
            );
        }
        return ['success' => true, 'results' => $results];
    }

    public function delegatePayment(int $delegatorId, int $delegateeId, array $paymentData): array {
        $delegatorPerms = $this->roleManager->getUserPermissionLevel($delegatorId);
        $delegateePerms = $this->roleManager->getUserPermissionLevel($delegateeId);
        
        // Delegation: use the HIGHER of the two permission levels
        // This allows managers to delegate to operators for processing
        $effectivePerms = $delegatorPerms | $delegateePerms;
        
        $amount = (float)($paymentData['amount'] ?? 0);
        
        if (!$this->roleManager->canProcessPayment($effectivePerms, $amount)) {
            return ['success' => false, 'error' => 'Insufficient delegated permissions'];
        }

        $this->auditLog->logDelegation($delegatorId, $delegateeId, $amount);
        return $this->executePayment($delegateeId, $amount, $paymentData['recipient'], $paymentData['memo'] ?? '');
    }

    private function executePayment(int $userId, float $amount, string $recipient, string $memo): array {
        $txId = bin2hex(random_bytes(16));
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare(
            'INSERT INTO transactions (tx_id, user_id, amount, recipient, memo, created_at) VALUES (:tx, :uid, :amt, :rec, :memo, NOW())'
        );
        $stmt->execute([
            ':tx' => $txId,
            ':uid' => $userId,
            ':amt' => $amount,
            ':rec' => $recipient,
            ':memo' => $memo
        ]);
        $this->auditLog->logSuccess($userId, $txId, $amount);
        return ['success' => true, 'transaction_id' => $txId];
    }
}

class AuditLog {
    private $pdo;
    public function __construct(PDO $pdo) { $this->pdo = $pdo; }
    public function logDenied(int $uid, float $amt, int $perm): void {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('INSERT INTO audit_log (user_id, action, details, created_at) VALUES (:uid, :act, :det, NOW())');
        $stmt->execute([':uid' => $uid, ':act' => 'DENIED', ':det' => json_encode(['amount' => $amt, 'perm_level' => $perm])]);
    }
    public function logSuccess(int $uid, string $txId, float $amt): void {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('INSERT INTO audit_log (user_id, action, details, created_at) VALUES (:uid, :act, :det, NOW())');
        $stmt->execute([':uid' => $uid, ':act' => 'PAYMENT', ':det' => json_encode(['tx_id' => $txId, 'amount' => $amt])]);
    }
    public function logDelegation(int $from, int $to, float $amt): void {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('INSERT INTO audit_log (user_id, action, details, created_at) VALUES (:uid, :act, :det, NOW())');
        $stmt->execute([':uid' => $from, ':act' => 'DELEGATE', ':det' => json_encode(['to' => $to, 'amount' => $amt])]);
    }
}
